title: 第19章 功败垂成第20章 庄周梦蝶
content_zh:
被柳露扔在地上的洛红颜此时正歪着头躺倒在地上，正对着自己，绝美的容颜好似童话里精致的睡美人。
“清荷！”长卿忍不住大喊道。
他目眦欲裂，不知从哪里来的力气，突然暴起，朝着洛红颜的方向飞奔而去。
甚至全然不顾他朝思暮想的百花令已经被他甩飞了出去，掉在了远处。
此时长卿的脑子里只有一个念头。
救人。
千钧一发之际，长卿终于赶到洛红颜的身边，爆发起全身的力量，他抱起洛红颜，堪堪躲过了柳露身上无数猩红触手缠绕起来，汇聚而成的一击。
严重的失血也让他再没有了力气，随即两人便一起倒在地上。
但他还是下意识地将女孩护在了身下，使用最后的灵力，催动起了窍穴中的骨刺灵。
数根肋骨从他的体内伸出，将洛红颜笼罩在其中，形成了对她最后的保护。
尽管知道这一切都是徒劳的，也完全没有必要。
有着重生的能力，一切都可以重来，眼前的死亡马上也会被自己逆转。
但他还是下意识地做了这些，就好像还在地球时，他总是会在和叶清荷散步时走在靠近马路的那一侧，自然而然。
尽管视线已经无比模糊，但是长卿还是艰难地向女孩的脸上看去，仿佛不甘心似的再次确认。
女孩精致绝美的容颜他是那么的熟悉，又是那么的让他痛苦。
“清荷......”
身后，柳露体内无数猩红触手汇聚在一起，带着雷霆威势挥落而下，将二人的身体碾得粉碎，骨肉化泥。
“对不起......”
脑海中那座诡异的钟表开始逆转。
表盘和指针好似噩梦般无定型的坍缩，蠕动，流淌，十二颗代表时间的眼珠，脓液似的在它的表面不断地形成又分解，闪烁着邪异的光芒。

再度睁开眼，长卿看到了那个熟悉的天花板。
他猛地从床上坐起，先是轻车熟路地确认了一下手机上的日期。
1月8日，没有变化。
紧接着那通熟悉的电话打来，长卿赶忙接起，看着视频中的女孩，恍如隔世。
“长卿，你好点了吗？”
熟悉的声音传来，却让长卿听后只觉宛如天籁。
强忍着流泪的冲动，长卿紧咬牙关，却说不出半句话来。
“怎么了，怎么不说话？”见他不回答，叶清荷有些疑惑问道。
“没什么。”长卿的声音略有些哽咽，他闭上眼，深吸了一口气，才恢复了平常。
“清荷，你是不是也做了那个梦。”
“梦？什么梦？”叶清荷却没有说出长卿想要的答案。
“洛红颜？”长卿再次问道。
“说什么呢，是不是烧糊涂了，你好些了没，还难受不？要不然等下了课我去看看你吧。”
见长卿一直在说些“胡话”叶清荷不免有些担心道。
叶清荷的话让长卿沉默了起来，也对自己的猜测产生了怀疑。
“不是和我一样，穿越到另一个世界了么......”
content_en:
Luo Hongyan, who was thrown to the ground by Liu Lu, was lying on the ground with her head tilted, facing her. Her beautiful face was like the exquisite sleeping beauty in the fairy tale.
"Qinghe!" Changqing couldn't help shouting.
His eyes were about to burst, and he suddenly gained strength from nowhere and flew towards Luo Hongyan.
Even the Baihua Ling, which completely ignored his thoughts, had been thrown away by him and fell far away.
At this time, Changqing had only one thought in his mind.
Save people.
At the critical moment, Chang Qing finally rushed to Luo Hongyan's side and exploded with all his strength. He picked up Luo Hongyan and barely dodged the attack from the countless scarlet tentacles wrapped around Liu Lu's body.
The severe blood loss also left him with no strength anymore, and then the two of them fell to the ground together.
But he still subconsciously protected the girl under him, and used his last spiritual power to activate the bone spur spirit in the acupoint.
Several ribs protruded from his body, shrouding Luo Hongyan, forming the last protection for her.
Even though I know it's all in vain and completely unnecessary.
With the ability to rebirth, everything can be repeated, and the death in front of you will be reversed immediately.
But he still did this subconsciously, as if when he was still on Earth, he would always walk on the side closer to the road when walking with Ye Qinghe, naturally.
Although his vision was extremely blurred, Chang Qing still looked at the girl's face with difficulty, confirming again as if he was unwilling to give in.
The girl's delicate and beautiful face was so familiar to him, and it made him so painful.
"Qinghe..."
Behind him, countless scarlet tentacles in Liu Lu's body gathered together and swung down with the power of thunder, crushing their bodies to pieces and turning their flesh and bones into mud.
"I'm sorry..."
The weird clock in my mind started to turn back.
The dial and hands are like a nightmare, amorphous collapse, squirming, and flowing. The twelve eyes representing time are constantly forming and decomposing on its surface like pus, shining with an evil light.
Opening his eyes again, Changqing saw the familiar ceiling.
He suddenly sat up from the bed and checked the date on his phone with ease.
January 8, no change.
Immediately after that familiar phone call came, Changqing hurriedly picked up the call and looked at the girl in the video as if he was in another world.
"Chang Qing, are you feeling better?"
The familiar voice came, but after hearing it, Changqing felt like the sound of nature.
Resisting the urge to cry, Chang Qing gritted his teeth, but could not say a word.
"What's wrong? Why don't you speak?" Seeing that he didn't answer, Ye Qinghe asked with some confusion.
"It's nothing." Changqing's voice was slightly choked. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath before returning to normal.
"Qinghe, did you also have that dream?"
"Dream? What dream?" Ye Qinghe did not give the answer Chang Qing wanted.
"Luo Hongyan?" Changqing asked again.
"What are you talking about? Are you feeling feverish? Are you feeling better? Are you still feeling uncomfortable? Otherwise, I'll go check on you after class."
Seeing that Changqing has been talking "nonsense", Ye Qinghe couldn't help but feel worried.
Ye Qinghe's words made Chang Qing silent, and he also doubted his guess.
"Aren't you like me and traveled to another world..."
